Business Development Executive (Construction Materials)

£40,000 - £45,000 (£55k+ OTE) + Bonus + Training + Benefits

Taunton

Are you a Business Development Executive or similar with a background in the construction industry or a related field, looking to join a highly reputable company, operating worldwide, offering not only impressive in-house training from industry experts, but also the opportunity to increase your earnings significantly through commission and bonuses?

Are you looking for a fully autonomous role, joining a rapidly growing company at the forefront of the specialist construction industry?

In this role you will be responsible for driving the growth of the business, building relationships with contractors and architects alike. Finally, you will also be responsible for developing and delivering CPD seminars, assisting with wider business growth strategy.

With 20 years of history behind them, this bespoke, specialist company are keen to continue dominating their niche sector of high-end, architectural glazing industry for years to come.

This role would suit a Business Development Manager with a background in the construction industry or a related field, looking for a challenging yet rewarding role within a specialist business.

The Role:
- Driving the growth of the business
- Building relationships with contractors and architects alike
- Cold calls and site visits
- Developing and delivering CPD seminars
- Monday - Friday, 08:30am - 17:30pm

- Business Development Executive
- Background in construction or a related field

Trainee Insurance Advisor (Cert CII Funded) Taunton

£27,000 £35,000 (depending on experience) Mon Fri, 08 00 + 1 Saturday morning a month

Taunton office-based (initial training is onsite in the office; any future flexibility/WFH options are discussed once established)

Looking to move out of retail, hospitality, or entry-level admin into a structured career with real progression?

We re working with an independent insurance brokerage in Taunton that trains people from scratch no insurance background needed. You ll learn how personal lines and commercial insurance work, help customers sort quotes, renewals, and policy changes over the phone and email, and work toward your Cert CII qualification with company backing.

What you ll get:
- £27k £35k starting salary + clear progression milestones and team/performance bonuses
- Fully funded Cert CII study to build long-term qualifications
- Hands-on training & support in a close-knit Taunton office not a giant call centre
- Predictable hours: 08 00 Mon Fri, plus one Saturday morning a month

Who this suits:
- Good communicator who enjoys helping people and solving problems calmly
- Organised and comfortable with computers and detail
- Happy working full-time in Taunton and willing to study for industry exams (solid GCSEs, including Maths, help)

UK Right to Work required. Apply now if shortlisted, I ll message you to confirm the hours, pay band, and office setup before booking a quick chat.

Cowell Recruitment Ltd. is an equal opportunity recruiter. E&OE.

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Development Sales Manager (Sales Advisor)

South-West region, Weston-Super-Mare

Competitive salary + attractive benefits

At Miller Homes we are building homes in a way which allows us to build better places for people to belong to, better homes for customers and better places for communities to thrive and nature to prosper. We are also creating a better working environment for our people. We create better places where people and planet prosper.

We are looking to recruit a Development Sales Manager (Sales Advisor) to join our fantastic South West region, ideally based around the Weston-Super-Mare region. The role will see you take responsibility for and manage the development sales function and be the primary Miller Homes contact for potential and existing customers. Having responsibility for securing the sale of homes and managing the customer journey in accordance with company standards, procedures and targets.

SALES ADVISOR RESPONSIBILITIES:
- To manage and control the Development sales function from pre-start to post completion
- Meet prospective customers and maintain primary point of contact throughout customer journey
- Manage the requirements and expectations of customers throughout the house buying process,
- Take responsibility for the development s presentation and ensure it reflects a strong sales message and the highest of standards

SALES ADVISOR REQUIREMENTS:
- Experience of high-performance in a Sales role
- A presentable, customer-facing professional with experience of dealing with customers and providing an exceptional standard of customer service
- Experienced in problem solving and the ability to analyse/report on issues that could affect the development
- Able to rapidly assimilate and assess situations and issues, offering solutions with maximum results

WHAT WE OFFER:
- Competitive basic salary
- 26 days annual leave + public holidays + your birthday off
- Excellent commission structure
- Company contribute 6.5% to your pension, plus other benefits
